subject: Daily AcreetionOS Update -- September 26, 2026
body:
**AcreetionOS Newsletter - September 26, 2026**

**Top Development:**

Shelly 3.1.5 Expands AUR Support

Shelly, the popular GUI package manager for Arch Linux, has just released version 3.1.5, which adds support for the AUR (Arch User Repository). This means that users can now easily browse and install packages from the AUR directly from the Shelly interface. This is a significant improvement for users who want to take advantage of the vast repository of user-submitted packages available on the AUR.

**Community News:**

* BetaNews has featured AcreetionOS as the easy-to-use alternative to Windows 10/11, highlighting its ease of use and stability.
* 9to5Linux and Linuxiac have covered the release of Shelly 3.1.5, which adds an AUR browser to the package manager.

**Practical Tip:**

Did you know that you can easily install AcreetionOS on a USB drive using the AcreetionMediaWriter tool? This tool allows you to write AcreetionOS to a USB drive from any operating system, making it easy to try out AcreetionOS without modifying your current system. Simply download the tool from the AcreetionOS website and follow the instructions to create a bootable USB drive.

Stay up-to-date with the latest developments and news from the AcreetionOS community by following us on social media and joining our Discord server.
